about_the_game: Immerse yourself in the dark allure of "Le Petit Mort" an upcoming JRPG that plunges you into an enchanting yet treacherous version of New York City, reimagined through the haunting lens of a vampire's existence. As a freshly embraced vampire from one of 12 distinctive clans—each boasting formidable powers, vexing curses, and intricate alliances—you’ll embark on a thrilling tale of survival filled with strategic choices and consequential relationships. Navigate the complex social landscape, balancing the ever-looming threat of hunger with your burgeoning powers, as you forge friendships, rivalries, and your very own faction among the city's supernatural elite. Whether you choose to steal from the wealthy, hone your skills through arduous training, or invest wisely for future gain, each decision shapes your path towards mastery or downfall. With randomized city events and engaging quests that usher you deeper into the heart of clan conspiracies, "Le Petit Mort" promises an unforgettable journey of temptation, betrayal, and the thrill of the nocturnal hunt—who will you become when the sun sets?

content_descriptors.notes: There is no sexual activity in this game. As a vampire you have the opportunity to choose options such as "Drink vampire blood, drink mortal blood, drink faerie blood, drink Harpie Blood," You can also give mortals some of your blood to allow them to rise as ghouled party members or to join your "gang." There are cutscenes of vampires drinking blood.

short_description: Dive into the darkness as a newly embraced vampire in NYC. Choose from 12 unique clans, forge alliances or rivalries, or craft your own faction as you navigate a thrilling world filled with strategy and treachery. Will you conquer the night or succumb to your hunger? Embrace your destiny on Steam!
